rejected.quote: Simply knowing how to read charts does not mean that you can make a living as a trader. You need a plan for getting into and out of trades, and you have to constantly make decisions about every position that you are holding.
rejected.reason: generic motivational framing for Part V's later chapters; states no bar-level condition of any kind

chapter_summary: This is a two-sentence, one-page section divider introducing Part V (Orders and Trade Management) with no chart examples, patterns, or numeric claims -- it only asserts that traders need an entry/exit plan, which the later chapters of Part V presumably supply. No mechanizable candidates were found; the single sentence was recorded under rejected for completeness.
